datasource that are restricted to a time range (ie. will not scan the full table).

column. For partitioned datasources, this implies that the data is organized by
time in partitions.

isMuted.description: If true, no notifications are sent on this channel
isMuted.title: Ismuted

mutingSchedules.description: If schedule is set, no notifications are sent on this channel during schedule
mutingSchedules.title: Mutingschedules

sslValidateCertificate.description: Whether to allow validation of the host's certificate
sslValidateCertificate.title: Sslvalidatecertificate

monitoring.description: Enable generation of incidents and notifications
monitoring.title: Monitoring

isLive.description: Pause the datasource to avoid any data access, it will overwrite query governance policy
isLive.title: Islive

pollingInterval.description: Frequency at which the metric collector and profiler will run
pollingInterval.title: Pollinginterval

activateSchemas.description: set to True to activate schemas by default. This could cause additional load on the datasource
activateSchemas.title: Activateschemas

forceScan.description: set to True to force scanning of data assets bypassing scan interval restrictions
forceScan.title: Forcescan

scanInterval.description: interval between 2 consecutive data asset scans
scanInterval.title: Scaninterval

allowPreviewsWhenPaused.description: Allow interactive queries (e.g. metric previews, failing records of incident) even if datasource is paused
allowPreviewsWhenPaused.title: Allowpreviewswhenpaused

allowRawDataSamples.description: Allow raw data samples to be shown on the UI
allowRawDataSamples.title: Allowrawdatasamples

allowRecordStorage.description: Allow storage of data records for incidents
allowRecordStorage.title: Allowrecordstorage

allowScheduleUuids.description: The list of allow schedule UUIDs, empty list means no limit
allowScheduleUuids.title: Allowscheduleuuids

cacheFailingRecordsCount.description: Allow failing records count to be fetched and cached automatically
cacheFailingRecordsCount.title: Cachefailingrecordscount

denyScheduleUuids.description: The list of deny schedule UUIDs, empty list means no limit
denyScheduleUuids.title: Denyscheduleuuids

indexedTimestampColumnsOnly.description: If set, do not allow configuration of metrics which don't use an indexed timestamp column.
indexedTimestampColumnsOnly.title: Indexedtimestampcolumnsonly

maxCategoricalDistinctCount.description: Allow categorical distributions to run if number of distinct values is below this value
maxCategoricalDistinctCount.title: Maxcategoricaldistinctcount

maxCategoricalDistinctPercent.description: Allow categorical distributions to run if percentage of distinct values is below this value. This is only used if number of distinct values is greater than 100
maxCategoricalDistinctPercent.title: Maxcategoricaldistinctpercent

maxQueryDurationInSeconds.description: The timeout duration for any query after which the query will be canceled.
maxQueryDurationInSeconds.title: Maxquerydurationinseconds

maxQueryPeriodInSeconds.description: The maximum query period that can be used for previewing a metric
maxQueryPeriodInSeconds.title: Maxqueryperiodinseconds

maxQueryRetries.description: The maximum number of continuous retries for a failing metric after which the metric will be paused.
maxQueryRetries.title: Maxqueryretries

saveCompleteFullCompareDiffSamples.description: To save complete full compare diff samples
saveCompleteFullCompareDiffSamples.title: Savecompletefullcomparediffsamples

lastScannedTs.description: Timestamp when last scanned by profiler
lastScannedTs.title: Lastscannedts

status.description: The metric status. Metric’s status only reflects the status for the metric itself. It doesn’t reflect any monitor status of monitors associated with that metric. For example, if a metric has been processed up-to-date but its monitors are still being processed, the metric’s status would be COMPLETED (instead of PENDING), and its monitors’ statuses would be PENDING.

incidentsCount.description: The number of incidents from this monitor since trigger request time to GET call time
incidentsCount.title: Incidentscount

monitorUuid.description: the UUID of the monitor to the metric associated with a trigger.
monitorUuid.title: Monitoruuid

incidentsCount.description: The number of incidents for this trigger (sum from all underlying metrics) since trigger request time to GET call time
incidentsCount.title: Incidentscount

metricStatuses.description: The detailed status for each metric.
metricStatuses.title: Metricstatuses

status.description: The trigger overall status. If any metric/monitor associated with this trigger is paused, the status is paused; otherwise, if any metric/monitor is pending, the status is pending; finally, all metrics/monitors are completed processing, the status is completed.

tableUuids.description: Add the UUID of each table to trigger. This triggers all trigger metrics for the table.
